title: Fig Tries a New Job
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'ew' and 'oe'.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar watching Nell the bee tidying a row of plants in a window box.
Fig the caterpillar crawling closer to the plant box, keen to help.
Fig the caterpillar climbing up onto the edge of the plant box.
Fig the caterpillar arranging small leaves neatly along the ledge.
Fig the caterpillar pausing beside the leaves, looking tempted.
Fig the caterpillar nibbling the edge of one leaf.
Fig the caterpillar nibbling through several leaves in a row.
The ledge now bare, every leaf nibbled away.
Nell the bee hovering over the bare ledge, surprised.
Fig the caterpillar and Nell the bee planting fresh leaves together on the ledge.
